blocks.title: 让 Agent 在你看得见的浏览器里工作
blocks.description: 复用你的登录态，读取真实页面并完成多步骤操作；涉及提交、发送或删除时始终停下来确认。

items.label: 页面环境
items.description: 不是静态 HTML 或模拟器

left.title: 只做网页搜索
items: 遇到登录态和复杂表单就会中断
无法复用当前页面上下文

right.title: 使用 Browser
items: 打开你正在使用的真实网站
读取页面结构并执行多步操作
高风险动作交还给你确认

blocks.title: 让 Agent 真正操作网页

items.title: 读取真实页面
items.description: 导航到网页并通过无障碍树快照定位内容，比传整页 HTML 更节省上下文。

items.title: 点击与填写
items.description: 支持点击、输入、选择、滚动和等待页面元素，可完成多步骤网页任务。

items.title: 登录态复用
items.description: 登录和二次验证由你在可见窗口完成，后续任务可按 profile 安全复用状态。

items.title: 任务与账号隔离
items.description: 不同 Agent 任务使用独立 session，同一任务的多个账号也可分别保存状态。

blocks.title: Let the agent work in a browser you can see
blocks.description: Reuse your sign-in state, read real pages and complete multi-step tasks. The agent always pauses before submitting, sending or deleting.

items.label: Page environment
items.description: Not static HTML or a simulator

blocks.title: From finding information to completing work

left.title: Web search only
items: Stops at sign-in and complex forms
Cannot reuse the current page context

right.title: With Browser
items: Open the real site you use
Read structure and execute multi-step actions
Hand high-risk actions back for confirmation

blocks.title: Let the agent operate the real web

items.title: Read real pages
items.description: Navigate and locate content through accessibility-tree snapshots with less context than full HTML.

items.title: Click and fill
items.description: Click, type, select, scroll and wait for elements across multi-step web tasks.

items.title: Reuse sign-in state
items.description: Handle sign-in and 2FA in a visible window, then safely reuse state through profiles.

items.title: Task and account isolation
items.description: Agent tasks use separate sessions, and multiple accounts within one task can keep separate state.
